meaning: to stress or emphasize a point

senses.en: to stress or emphasize a point

examples.zh: 老师强调，明天一定要带书。
examples.en: The teacher stressed that we must bring our books tomorrow.

examples.zh: 医生一直强调，饭后要吃药。
examples.en: The doctor keeps stressing that I take the medicine after meals.

examples.zh: 他没强调时间，只说了地方。
examples.en: He didn't stress the time; he only mentioned the place.

examples.zh: 房间里太热了，打开空调吧。
examples.en: It's too hot in the room; let's turn on the air conditioning.

examples.zh: 这台空调声音很大，我晚上睡不好。
examples.en: This air conditioner is loud, so I don't sleep well at night.

examples.zh: 你家有空调吗？
examples.en: Do you have air conditioning at home?

examples.zh: 这个手机的优点是便宜。
examples.en: The advantage of this phone is that it's cheap.

examples.zh: 每个人都有自己的优点。
examples.en: Everyone has their own strengths.

examples.zh: 住在城市有什么优点？
examples.en: What are the advantages of living in a city?

meaning: reader (of a book, paper or magazine)

senses.en: reader (of a book, paper or magazine)

examples.zh: 这本书的读者很多，都是年轻人。
examples.en: This book has many readers, all of them young people.

examples.zh: 欢迎读者给我们写信。
examples.en: Readers are welcome to write to us.

examples.zh: 他是这家报纸的老读者。
examples.en: He is a longtime reader of this newspaper.

meaning: family members of a person, e.g. a patient

senses.en: family members of a person, e.g. a patient

note: Relatives of a specific person (often a patient); not "family" in general.

examples.zh: 病人的家属在外面等。
examples.en: The patient's family is waiting outside.

examples.zh: 医生请病人的家属到办公室来。
examples.en: The doctor asked the patient's family to come to the office.

examples.zh: 请问，你是病人的家属吗？
examples.en: Excuse me, are you a family member of the patient?

examples.zh: 这里停车要收费吗？
examples.en: Do they charge for parking here?

examples.zh: 这个公园不收费，大家都可以进去。
examples.en: This park charges no fee; everyone can go in.

examples.zh: 那家医院怎么收费？
examples.en: How does that hospital charge?

examples.zh: 我爷爷以前是农民。
examples.en: My grandfather used to be a farmer.

examples.zh: 这些农民每天很早就起床。
examples.en: These farmers get up very early every day.

examples.zh: 他不想当农民，想去城市工作。
examples.en: He doesn't want to be a farmer; he wants to work in the city.

note: Used in health, safety and environment contexts; "危害 + health" is a fixed pairing.

examples.zh: 喝太多酒会危害身体健康。
examples.en: Drinking too much harms your health.

examples.zh: 不睡觉对身体的危害很大。
examples.en: Not sleeping does great harm to the body.

examples.zh: 你知道喝太多酒有什么危害吗？
examples.en: Do you know what harm drinking too much does?

examples.zh: 周末我去医院当志愿者。
examples.en: On weekends I volunteer at the hospital.

examples.zh: 比赛需要很多志愿者。
examples.en: The competition needs many volunteers.

examples.zh: 这些志愿者都是大学生。
examples.en: These volunteers are all university students.

examples.zh: 这条铁路从北京到上海。
examples.en: This railway runs from Beijing to Shanghai.

examples.zh: 他家就在铁路旁边，火车声音很大。
examples.en: His home is right beside the railway, and the trains are loud.

examples.zh: 这里以后会有一条新铁路。
examples.en: There will be a new railway here in the future.

examples.zh: 我的房东住在楼上。
examples.en: My landlord lives upstairs.

examples.zh: 空调坏了，我要告诉房东。
examples.en: The air conditioner is broken; I need to tell the landlord.

examples.zh: 你把钱给房东了吗？
examples.en: Have you given the money to the landlord?

examples.zh: 在这儿我没有熟人。
examples.en: I don't know anyone here.

examples.zh: 他在机场看到了一个熟人。
examples.en: He ran into an acquaintance at the airport.

examples.zh: 找熟人帮忙，事情会容易一些。
examples.en: Asking someone you know for help makes things a bit easier.

examples.zh: 今年我们的收入增长了很多。
examples.en: Our income grew a lot this year.

examples.zh: 城市的人口在不断增长。
examples.en: The city's population keeps growing.

examples.zh: 多看书，你的知识会增长。
examples.en: Read more, and your knowledge will grow.

note: Describes a pattern in general; not for one single event or the future.

examples.zh: 周末我往往十点才起床。
examples.en: On weekends I often don't get up until ten.

examples.zh: 他往往一个人吃饭。
examples.en: He usually eats alone.

examples.zh: 便宜的东西往往不太好。
examples.en: Cheap things are often not that good.

meaning: long ago; already (a long time ago)

senses.en: long ago; already (a long time ago)

note: More written than 早就; stresses that it was a long time ago.

examples.zh: 他早已回国了。
examples.en: He went back to his country long ago.

examples.zh: 我早已知道这件事了。
examples.en: I have known about this for a long time.

examples.zh: 我到的时候，他们早已走了。
examples.en: By the time I arrived, they had long since left.

examples.zh: 我们都要注意环保。
examples.en: We should all pay attention to protecting the environment.

examples.zh: 用自己的杯子比较环保。
examples.en: Using your own cup is more eco-friendly.

examples.zh: 这个杯子是环保的吗？
examples.en: Is this bag eco-friendly?

meaning: to receive and host guests or clients

senses.en: to receive and host guests or clients

examples.zh: 今天公司要接待一位客人。
examples.en: The company will receive a guest today.

examples.zh: 他在酒店工作，负责接待客人。
examples.en: He works at a hotel and is in charge of receiving guests.

examples.zh: 谢谢你们的热情接待。
examples.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality.

examples.zh: 从这里到机场可以走高速公路。
examples.en: From here to the airport you can take the expressway.

examples.zh: 高速公路上车很多，开慢一点。
examples.en: There's lots of traffic on the expressway; drive a bit slower.

examples.zh: 这条高速公路要收费吗？
examples.en: Is there a toll on this expressway?

examples.zh: 这家饭馆有什么特色菜？
examples.en: What are the specialty dishes at this restaurant?

examples.zh: 每个城市都有自己的特色。
examples.en: Every city has its own character.

examples.zh: 这个地方很有特色。
examples.en: This place has a lot of character.

note: Formal; actions or work reflect a quality.

examples.zh: 这件事体现了他的想法。
examples.en: This matter reflects his way of thinking.

examples.zh: 他的好习惯体现在小事上。
examples.en: His good habits show in small things.

examples.zh: 这个菜体现了这里的特色。
examples.en: This dish reflects the character of this place.
